rationale: Record per-commit performance changes that cross these families' selectors. The materialized runtime entry answers captured-state resolution with one registry pass (__pulpFindMaterializedElements__ returns exactly what __pulpFindMaterializedElement__ returns for each query; a node is match-tested only when it carries the attributes a plain-compound target names), and the web-compat selector engine memoizes _parseSelector by selector text. Skill docs record the hydrate-before-first-render pattern. No importer lowering, DesignIR shape, capture path, renderer selection, asset format, fixture or threshold changes, and no existing test's verdict changes. Registered as watch-only so the families' coverage stays honest. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
